before_the_freeze: Feasibility probes (2026-11-23, before commit 073d0a4) encoded 3 development pages and one invented query ('What is the median exit valuation in USD million?') to time the model and check determinism and the two-pass equivalence. No annotated question was scored.
The held-out selection rule was executed before the freeze to record its output in the spec; it reads only document type, size and page count.

events: Started 11:53Z. The Mac slept with the lid closed from about 12:19Z to 13:24Z; the process paused and resumed.
About 15:15Z the Claude Code session that launched the run ended and the run was killed. Pass 1 was complete: 837/837 feature files, none corrupt (newest 25 reloaded), no partial files.
Resumed from the pass-1 checkpoints as a detached process; no completed page was recomputed.
The first analysis execution stopped in the save cell (NumPy int64 not JSON serialisable); fixed in serialisation only and re-run.

changes_after_the_spec_freeze.rule: None changes the model, preprocessing, rankings, guard, metrics, statistics or decision rule. Verified: a fresh execution regenerates summary.json, per_question.csv and all 525 rankings byte for byte (notebook 04 section 10), and two-pass embeddings equal the single-pass forward bit for bit.
notebook_04: Parity checks against src/visualdoc moved from the notebook to the independent audit (an AGENTS.md amendment to allow the import was not made).

Atomic cache writes (temporary file, fsync, rename) and removal of stale temporaries and of pass-1 features whose embedding exists; added while pass 1 was running, used from pass 2 on. Pass-1 files were written with safetensors.save_file directly and all reload.
Cost table reads model-load times from the encoding log; JSON serialisation converts NumPy numbers; NaN saved as null; display fixes in the breakdown and examples cells.
Single-pass check labels queries by question id instead of their first 40 characters (found by the audit).
changes_after_the_spec_freeze.pyproject: Added a 'visual' extra (pillow, psutil, safetensors, torch==2.15.0, transformers==5.23.0).
